svg.title: Work orders and daily operation schedules
svg.desc: Work orders and daily operation schedules. Which two fields match a scheduled operation to available daily capacity? Primary tables: WorkOrder, WorkOrderOperation, WorkOrderOperationSchedule. No WorkCenterCalendarID is stored on the schedule. Joining on work center alone repeats calendar capacity.
